# Pace Productivity

> Defining the speed of life. A gamified task manager, habit tracker, and real-time collaboration workspace.

## Overview
Pace (available at https://pace-manager.web.app/) is a modern productivity application built to help individuals, students, and teams organize tasks, sustain habits, and build momentum.

## Core Features
- **Gamified Consistency System**: Earn points for completing tasks, build daily streaks, achieve Flawless Days (completing all tasks due on that day), and earn Streak Shields (1 shield per 3 flawless days, max 3 shields) to protect streaks when life happens.
- **Natural Language AI Assistant**: Generate and refine tasks, subtasks, timelines, and themes using conversational language.
- **Visual Scheduling**: Month calendar grid and interactive hourly timeline view. Habits and recurring tasks do not clutter calendar days.
- **Study & Reading Tracker**: Dedicated progress cards for books and learning modules with item incrementing and page completion percentage.
- **Real-time Team Collaboration**: Multi-member tasks with live in-task messaging and member assignment.
- **Offline-First PWA**: Progressive Web App capabilities for instant offline access and automatic synchronization upon reconnecting.
- **Aesthetic Custom Themes**: Pre-built themes (Modern, Snowwy, Pookie, Cyberpunk, Forest) plus an interactive custom theme generator.

## Technical Details
- **Platform**: Progressive Web App (PWA) compatible with Web, iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows.
- **Hosting**: Firebase Hosting (`pace-manager.web.app`).
- **Database**: Cloud Firestore with offline local persistence.
- **Authentication**: Firebase Authentication with Google Sign-in, email/password, and instant Demo Mode.
- **Pricing**: 100% Free to use.
